_meta.indication: Treatment of patients with Hodgkin lymphoma after failure of autologous stem cell transplant (ASCT) or after failure of at least two prior multi-agent chemotherapy regimens in patients who are not ASCT candidates; and treatment of patients with systemic anaplastic large cell lymphoma after failure of at least one prior multi-agent chemotherapy regimen

pivotal_trials.population: 102 patients with Hodgkin lymphoma who relapsed after autologous stem cell transplant; median of 5 prior therapies
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Overall objective response rate (ORR = CR + PR) per independent review facility
pivotal_trials.result: ORR 73% (95% CI 65, 83) with median DOR 6.7 months; complete remission rate 32% (95% CI 23, 42) with median DOR 20.5 months

nct_ctgov.title: A Pivotal Open-Label Trial of Brentuximab Vedotin for Hodgkin Lymphoma

pivotal_trials.population: 58 patients with relapsed systemic anaplastic large cell lymphoma; median of 2 prior therapies, 72% ALK-negative
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Overall response rate (ORR = CR + PR) per independent review facility
pivotal_trials.result: ORR 86% (95% CI 77, 95) with median DOR 12.6 months; complete remission rate 57% (95% CI 44, 70) with median DOR 13.2 months

nct_ctgov.title: A Phase 2 Open Label Trial of Brentuximab Vedotin (SGN-35) for Systemic Anaplastic Large Cell Lymphoma

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (>=20%) were neutropenia, peripheral sensory neuropathy, fatigue, nausea, anemia, upper respiratory tract infection, diarrhea, pyrexia, rash, thrombocytopenia, cough, and vomiting; serious adverse reactions were reported in 31% of patients; adverse reactions led to treatment discontinuation in 21% (most commonly peripheral sensory neuropathy 8%)
target_moa: Antibody-drug conjugate directed against CD30: a chimeric IgG1 anti-CD30 antibody (cAC10) linked via a protease-cleavable linker to the antimicrotubule agent monomethyl auristatin E (MMAE)

advisory_committee.vote: On July 14, 2011 the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee (ODAC) voted unanimously in favor of accelerated approval for this application

description.text: Added new indication for treatment of classical Hodgkin lymphoma patients at high risk of relapse or progression as post-autologous HSCT consolidation

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental biologics application provides for a new indication for the treatment of patients with classical Hodgkin lymphoma at high risk of relapse or progression as post-autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (auto-HSCT) consolidation based on the final study report from Study SGN35-005 entitled, "Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicenter, phase 3 study to compare the safety and efficacy of brentuximab vedotin and best supportive care (BSC) versus placebo and BSC in the treatment of patients at high risk of residual HL following autologous stem cell transplant (ASCT)."

description.text: Added indication for adult patients with primary cutaneous anaplastic large cell lymphoma or CD30-expressing mycosis fungoides who have received prior systemic therapy

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental biologics application provides a new indication for adult patients with primary cutaneous anaplastic large cell lymphoma or CD30-expressing mycosis fungoides who have received prior systemic therapy.

description.text: Added new indication for adult patients with previously untreated Stage III or IV classical Hodgkin lymphoma, in combination with chemotherapy

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental biologics application provides for the approval of a new indication for adult patients with previously untreated Stage III or IV classical Hodgkin lymphoma, in combination with chemotherapy.

description.text: Added indication for previously untreated systemic anaplastic large cell lymphoma or other CD30-expressing peripheral T-cell lymphomas in combination with cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, and prednisone

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental biologics application provides for the addition of a new indication for the treatment of adult patients with previously untreated systemic anaplastic large cell lymphoma or other CD30-expressing peripheral T-cell lymphomas (PTCL), including angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma and PTCL not otherwise specified, in combination with cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, and prednisone.

description.text: Added treatment of pediatric patients 2 years and older with previously untreated high risk classical Hodgkin lymphoma in combination with doxorubicin, vincristine, etoposide, prednisone, and cyclophosphamide

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental biologics license application provides for the use of Adcetris (brentuximab vedotin) for the treatment of pediatric patients 2 years and older with previously untreated high risk classical Hodgkin lymphoma (cHL) in combination with doxorubicin, vincristine, etoposide, prednisone, and cyclophosphamide.

description.text: Labeling update adding second interim overall survival results from ECHELON-1 for A+AVD in advanced classical Hodgkin lymphoma (no new indication)

citations.quote:
- Section 14 Clinical Studies, revised to include results of the second interim analysis of overall survival in study ECHELON-1 (C25003), entitled "A Randomized, Open label, Phase 3 Trial of A+AVD Versus ABVD as Frontline Therapy in Patients With Advanced Classical Hodgkin Lymphoma."
- Section 5 Warnings and Precautions, revised to include updated peripheral neuropathy outcomes.

description.text: Added new indication: brentuximab vedotin in combination with lenalidomide and a rituximab product for relapsed or refractory large B-cell lymphoma after two or more lines of therapy in patients ineligible for auto-HSCT or CAR T-cell therapy

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental biologics license application provides for a new indication: Adcetris (brentuximab vedotin) in combination with lenalidomide and a rituximab product for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory large B-cell lymphoma (LBCL), including diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) not otherwise specified (NOS), DLBCL arising from indolent lymphoma, or high-grade B-cell lymphoma (HGBL), after two or more lines of systemic therapy who are not eligible for autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (auto-HSCT) or chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell therapy.

surrogate_endpoint.text: Overall response/complete remission rate (SG035-0003: 32% complete remission rate with median duration of response of 20.5 months), considered a clinical endpoint other than survival or irreversible morbidity

citations.quote: The complete remission rate of 32% with a median duration of 20.5 months can be considered as a "clinical endpoint other than survival or irreversible morbidity" as per 21 CFR 601.41 (Accelerated Approval regulations).
These indications are based on response rate. There are no data available demonstrating improvement in patient reported outcomes or survival with ADCETRIS.

confirmatory_requirement.text: Required confirmatory trials to verify clinical benefit; successful completion of either the frontline sALCL (CH-P vs CHOP) or frontline HL (AVD vs ABVD) phase 3 trial could convert the accelerated approval to regular approval for both indications

citations.quote: Granting of these approvals are contingent upon completion of clinical trials to verify the clinical benefit of brentuximab vedotin, as outlined in your letter of July 22, 2011.
Successful completion of either PMR 1 or PMR 2 could be considered to convert the accelerated approval to regular approval for both the Hodgkin lymphoma and sALCL indications.

orphan_indication.text: Orphan drug designation granted to brentuximab vedotin for the Hodgkin lymphoma indication on 30 January 2007

citations.quote: FDA granted orphan drug designation to brentuximab vedotin for the Hodgkin lymphoma indication on 30 January 2007.

summary.text: ADCETRIS received accelerated approval under 21 CFR 601.40-46 based on the single-arm Phase 2 trial SG035-0003 (32% complete remission rate, median DOR 20.5 months), reviewed as a Priority BLA with orphan drug designation; ODAC voted unanimously in favor of accelerated approval, and approval was contingent upon confirmatory trials to verify clinical benefit.

citations.quote: As requested in your letter of February 25, 2011, marketing approval of this product is granted under the accelerated approval of biological products regulations, 21 CFR 601.40-46.

The recommendation for accelerated approval is based on the single, Phase 2, single arm, clinical trial SG035-0003 in which brentuximab vedotin showed a 32% complete remission rate with a median duration of response of 20.5 months.
FDA granted orphan drug designation to brentuximab vedotin for the Hodgkin lymphoma indication on 30 January 2007.
On July 14, 2011, the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee (ODAC) met in the morning to discuss this application. ODAC voted unanimously in favor of accelerated approval for this application.

requirement.text: Confirmatory trial: a randomized phase 3 trial of brentuximab vedotin in combination with AVD versus ABVD as frontline therapy in patients with advanced Hodgkin Lymphoma; at least 880 patients, primary endpoint progression free survival

citations.quote: 2. **CONFIRMATORY TRIAL** - A randomized phase 3 trial of SGN-35 (brentuximab vedotin) in combination with AVD versus ABVD as frontline therapy in patients with advanced Hodgkin Lymphoma. Enrollment of at least 880 patients is expected with a primary endpoint of progression free survival determined by an independent blinded review facility. Overall survival is a key secondary endpoint.
